imp_instr_1: 1. Fill in the sheets for the data you want to import (Machines, Warehouse items, Recurring reminders, Users, Pending jobs or Work history). You can import a single sheet or all of them at once with the «Whole workbook» option; sheets left empty are ignored.
imp_instr_2: 2. Columns in red are required. The second row is an example: delete it or replace it with your data.
imp_instr_3: 3. Machines: to place a machine inside another, put the parent in «Parent machine» (or the full path, e.g. «Line 1 > Furnace»). Parent machines and zones that don't exist are created automatically.
imp_instr_4: 4. Items: the location is given by zone, shelving unit, shelf (number, letter or «Floor») and section (optional). If they don't exist, they are created automatically. The initial stock is recorded as «Initial stock».
imp_instr_5: 5. Reminders: dates can be Excel dates or text (DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD). Choose the frequency from the drop-down list. The technician is given by username or name.
imp_instr_6: 6. Users: passwords are not imported. A temporary password is generated for each user, who will have to change it on first login.
imp_instr_7: 7. Import from File > Import from Excel/CSV. Before importing you will see a row-by-row preview and a backup will be saved.
imp_fila_ejemplo: Example row from the template: not imported
imp_ayuda_libro: With «Whole workbook» all sheets are imported at once, each one according to its type and always in this order: users, machines, items, reminders, pending jobs and work history (so a reminder or a job can be linked to a technician or a machine from the earlier sheets).

lbl_info_contrasena_copias:
With a password, backups (manual ones, the automatic one on closing and the ones made before deleting or importing) are saved encrypted: if someone takes the USB drive or gets into the NAS or cloud where you keep them, they cannot open them. On this computer they are restored without asking for it; on another computer, it is asked for.

If you forget it, there is no way to recover the encrypted backups: write it down somewhere safe.

lbl_info_cifrado_bd:
With encryption, mantenimiento.db and almacen.db are stored encrypted (SQLCipher, AES-256): anyone who copies the files or takes the disk cannot read them. The key is kept in the system keyring and MantPro opens the data by itself, without asking for anything. Photos are not encrypted.

Backups contain the data unencrypted, so they can be restored on another computer: protect them with File → Backup password.

The change is made when MantPro is opened again: when you press the button, MantPro closes.
lbl_sin_sqlcipher: This MantPro installation does not include SQLCipher, so it cannot encrypt the databases. Use the version from the downloads page (Windows, AppImage, .deb, .rpm) or full-disk encryption.
lbl_sin_llavero: The system keyring cannot be found: the key would be saved in a file in the data folder, which protects much less (anyone who takes the whole folder can open the data).
lbl_info_clave_recuperacion: Keep this key somewhere safe and outside this computer (written on paper, in a password manager…). If the system keyring loses the key (system reinstalled, new user…), MantPro will ask you for it, and without it the data cannot be opened.

cmp_msg_confirmar_recibido: Mark the whole order as received? This does not change the stock: entries are recorded with “📥 Entry”.
cmp_msg_confirmar_cancelar: Cancel this order? What was still to arrive will no longer count as pending.
cmp_msg_confirmar_borrar: Delete this order? It disappears from the list and no longer counts as pending.
cmp_tt_seleccion: Select several rows (Ctrl or Shift) and tick or untick them at once; the space bar also works.
lbl_nube_sin_sesion: This PC is not connected to MantPro Cloud.
lbl_nube_info:
MantPro Cloud keeps your data in the cloud and up to date across several PCs and phones, even when they are not on the same network. Sign in with the account we gave you when you subscribed.

MantPro works exactly the same on this PC without the cloud: if you don't sign in, nothing changes.
lbl_nube_conectado: This PC is connected to MantPro Cloud.
lbl_nube_gracia: The license has expired. Renew it before the grace period ends so you don't lose synchronization.
lbl_nube_vencida: The license has expired and this PC no longer syncs with the cloud. MantPro keeps working locally with your data and you can export it whenever you want. Renew the license to sync again.
lbl_nube_suspendida: The account is suspended. MantPro keeps working locally with your data. Contact MantPro Cloud.
msg_nube_confirmar_cerrar:
Sign out of MantPro Cloud on this PC?

Your maintenance data is not touched: MantPro keeps working locally.
nube_error_sin_conexion: Can't connect to MantPro Cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
nube_error_respuesta: MantPro Cloud replied with something unexpected. Try again later.
nube_error_intentos: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes before trying again.
nube_error_url: The MantPro Cloud address is not secure (it must be HTTPS).
nube_error_sesion: Your MantPro Cloud session has expired or been closed. Sign in again.
nube_error_otro: The operation could not be completed.
nube_error_empresa: This PC is already synchronised with another MantPro Cloud company. The data of two companies cannot be mixed: sign in with the usual account.
nube_error_licencia_caducada: The licence has expired: you can view your data, but you cannot upload changes. Renew it to synchronise again.
nube_error_licencia_suspendida: The account is suspended and cannot be synchronised. Contact MantPro Cloud.
nube_error_espacio: The storage space of your MantPro Cloud plan is full. Free up space or change plan.
nube_error_bd: The databases could not be opened to synchronise. Try again in a few seconds.
lbl_nube_fotos_aparte: MantPro uploads what you change almost immediately and checks for anything new every minute while it is open. Photos are synchronised separately, in the background.
lbl_nube_omitidos: Warning: {n} records were too large and could not be uploaded.
msg_nube_sync_al_dia: All up to date: there was nothing new to upload.
nube_error_copia: The backup could not be made before changing your data, so nothing has been touched.
msg_nube_necesita_decision: MantPro Cloud needs your decision: Tools → MantPro Cloud…
msg_nube_con_datos:
The MantPro Cloud account already has data and this PC has its own too. To avoid mixing them, nothing has been synchronised.

Do you want to use the cloud data? The data on this PC will be replaced by the cloud data (a backup is made first).
msg_nube_restaurada:
It looks like you have restored an old backup of this PC. To avoid duplicating data, synchronisation is stopped.

Do you want to recover the data from the cloud? The data on this PC will be replaced by the cloud data (a backup is made first).
lbl_nube_restaurada: Synchronisation stopped: a backup has been restored. Recover the data from the cloud to continue.
msg_nube_adoptado:
Cloud data received: {n} records.

Close MantPro and open it again to start with them (you will have to sign in again).
msg_nube_stock_negativo:
After synchronising, these items have NEGATIVE stock. Do an urgent stock count:

{lista}
lbl_nube_aviso_bajada: {n} records from the cloud could not be fully applied.
msg_video_no_valido: «{nombre}» cannot be added: it is larger than 100 MB or is not a valid video.
msg_video_no_en_pc: This video is not on this PC yet (it will arrive when syncing).
